findings.highlight: I'm probably not the only one who feels like this. Archer probably feels he same way.
findings.evidenceJa: それは俺だけじゃなく、アーチャー自身も同じ筈だ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers that Archer probably feels the same incompatibility.
findings.explanation: A missing word breaks Shirou’s inference about Archer.

findings.highlight: There must be a total of three people in the world with whom I'm just completely incompatible.
findings.evidenceJa: ここまで性が合わない相手っていうのは、世界中捜しても三人といまい。
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that even searching the whole world, there would probably not be three people this incompatible with him.
findings.explanation: Extreme rarity becomes an exact worldwide count of three.

findings.highlight: With a fair amount of hostility, Archer makes it clear he sees right through me.
findings.evidenceJa: 確かな敵意を感じさせて、アーチャーは俺を射抜いた。
findings.governingReading: Archer fixes Shirou with a gaze that metaphorically pierces him and plainly conveys hostility.
findings.explanation: A hostile gaze becomes psychological insight.

findings.evidenceJa: それが真実だからという事もある。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is shaken partly because Archer’s charge about Saber’s burden is true.
findings.explanation: The truth of Archer’s accusation becomes merely his sincerity.

findings.highlight: "Do you really expect to end this war without fighting? Do you really think you'll never fight or kill anyone?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「おまえは本気で、戦わずにこの争いを終わらせるつもりか。誰とも争わず、誰も殺さず、誰をも殺させないと？」
findings.governingReading: Archer asks whether Shirou means to finish the conflict without fighting anyone, killing anyone, or allowing anyone to be killed.
findings.explanation: Archer’s third condition—preventing anyone else from being killed—disappears.

findings.highlight: "I have no intention of butting into your moronic reasons for doing what you do. I don't have the time, and I'm just not crazy enough to try."
findings.evidenceJa: 「おまえの甘ったるい考えに邪魔などせんよ。そんな余裕はないし、そこまで酔狂ではない」
findings.governingReading: Archer calls Shirou’s thinking or outlook naïvely sweet and says he will not interfere with it.
findings.explanation: Archer’s contempt for a saccharine outlook becomes an attack on Shirou’s reasons.

findings.highlight: "Don't get things confused, though. This champion of justice you're pretending to be? Nothing more than a cleaner. You should know that only the survivor is going to have a chance to save anyone that way."
findings.evidenceJa: 「だが間違えるな。おまえが気取る正義の味方とは、ただの掃除屋だ。その方法で救えるものは、生き残った者だけと知れ」
findings.governingReading: Archer says Shirou's method can save only those who have survived.
findings.explanation: The survivors Shirou can save become survivors who can save others, changing Archer's criticism of the limits of rescue.

findings.highlight: But it felt like Archer was just beating up on me for no reason.
findings.evidenceJa: その言葉に、理由もなく全身を打ちのめされたような気が、した。
findings.governingReading: For reasons Shirou cannot explain, Archer’s words make him feel as though his whole body has been struck down.
findings.explanation: Words crushing Shirou become Archer beating up on him.

findings.highlight: Listen. Your approach won't undo a tragic death.
findings.evidenceJa: いいか、その方法では悲しい出来事、悲惨な死を元に戻す事は出来ない。
findings.governingReading: Archer says Shirou’s method cannot undo sad events or tragic deaths.
findings.explanation: Sad events and tragic deaths collapse into one tragic death.

findings.highlight: Someday you're going to face reality, and you'll have to pay the price. The choices you've made will cost many, many lives."
findings.evidenceJa: ならばいつか現実に直面し、その折り合いのツケを支払う時がくる。おまえのその選択が、多くの命を奪う事もあるだろうよ」
findings.governingReading: Archer warns that Shirou's chosen course may also result in many deaths.
findings.explanation: Archer's warning that this choice may cost lives becomes a categorical prediction that Shirou's choices will kill many people.

findings.highlight: "You should at least be prepared. By the time you realize how narrow-minded you've been, you'll have to figure out how to fix it, and who to punish for it.
findings.evidenceJa: 「覚悟ぐらいはしておけ。己の矮小さを実感した時、まず何を正し、誰を罰するかと。
findings.governingReading: Archer anticipates Shirou confronting his own smallness or inadequacy, in a discussion of how little people can accomplish.
findings.explanation: Archer's warning about confronting one's own inadequacy becomes a specific accusation of narrow-mindedness.
